title: Causal_Assessment_Object (NFRA_EPISTEMY S6, PROPOSED 0.1.1 -- CTO arch gate 63695 applied: PASS-TO-EXERCISE)
description: Source of record for the causal-assessment object (PRD_EPISTEMIC_MECHANIZATION sec.2.4/2.5). An assessment is IMMUTABLE; current eligibility is a SEPARATE object (Eligibility_Evaluation). Authored at CRO base as registry executor; exercised by 4.0.0_SA_CRO~C against real atom_layer0 bundles (C9-RIDE). Status PROPOSED; CTO arch gate 63695 PASS-TO-EXERCISE (2026-08-20 2042Z) applied in 0.1.1: (a) single-member status enum CUT (proposed-ness is the PROJECT status, never a per-instance field); (b) the required set AUDITED for honest-populability -- every field the producer cannot honestly fill at produce vintage is nullable WITH A DECLARED ABSENCE SEMANTIC (null means the named state, never omitted); (c) result_status is READ-ONLY-BY-CONSTRUCTION for every downstream consumer. Final acceptance follows the first real instance (4.0.0_SA_CRO~C C9-RIDE Phase 1) + CVO verify. Rule-24 record: S6_CAUSAL_ASSESSMENT_OBJECT_RULE24_RECORD.md (same dir).

knowledge_basis.description: PRD sec.2.3 -- pinned; any change is an invalidation event for eligibility, never for history. ABSENCE SEMANTIC (gate 63695): null = NO RATIFIED ARTIFACT EXISTS for that basis member at produce vintage (UNRATIFIED_BASIS) -- a declared state, never an omission; the producer MUST NOT invent a version string. Each null member is an open invalidation predicate by construction (a lease cannot evaluate support it cannot name).

subject_scope.description: a PREDICATE over the canonical graph, never a hand roster

stated_as.description: never a truth claim inside the object

space_ref.description: ratified Space per defect class, @version. ABSENCE SEMANTIC: null = NO RATIFIED SPACE for this defect class at produce vintage -- live_candidates is then PRODUCER-ENUMERATED and discrimination.declared_total MUST be false (a complement cannot be printed against a space nobody ratified)

known_residual.description: counts as SURVIVORS under every outcome (PRD sec.2.4)

reason_class.description: only RULED_OUT_BY_EVIDENCE removes from live_candidates; the others stay in known_residual

instrument_attestation_ref.description: ABSENCE SEMANTIC: null = the instrument is NOT ATTESTED at produce vintage (no Instrument_Attestation exists); the row is admissible as evidence only at basis desired, never as a discriminating row

grounding.description: file:line @ commit, tool+output, or live primitive -- a citation without a vintage is not a citation

denominator_grain.description: ABSENCE SEMANTIC (both fields together): null = the datum is UNFRAMED -- the producer cannot state what it is a count OF; an unframed row is inadmissible to discrimination (worst_case_residual / guaranteed_elimination exclude it) and the count of unframed rows is printed by the consumer, never hidden

counterevidence.description: ABSENCE SEMANTIC: [] = NONE RECORDED by the producer, never none-exists (a bundle cannot enumerate its own absences)

discrimination.description: PRD sec.2.4 floor fields; INSTRUMENT_FAILED is operational, never evidentiary; UNMODELED_MECHANISM is mechanically unclosable

policy_ref.description: named + versioned task policy under which this assessment was produced. ABSENCE SEMANTIC: null = NO NAMED POLICY existed at produce vintage -- itself a finding the consumer surfaces (PRD sec.2.5: every assessment is produced under a policy; a null here is the pre-policy regime, declared)

result_status.description: the scoped status ladder as PRODUCED at vintage; DISCRIMINATED_WITHIN carries (tested_set, known_residual, scope) by reference. READ-ONLY-BY-CONSTRUCTION FOR EVERY DOWNSTREAM CONSUMER (gate 63695): a produced status is a fact about an act at a vintage and never changes; CURRENT status is recomputed by Eligibility_Evaluation -- two objects, two clocks; a consumer that writes this field has silently merged the clocks, and the merge validates, which is why it is forbidden here and not detected downstream

derivation_trace.description: ABSENCE SEMANTIC: [] = HAND_DERIVED (no named rule consumed evidence) -- declared, so a rule-engine trace and a hand trace are never confused

graph_snapshot.description: ABSENCE SEMANTIC: null = no graph snapshot id was addressable at produce vintage (registry_commit still binds)

support_pointers.description: the support closure for lease evaluation (stage 4) -- content-digest grain where the claim is about content. ABSENCE SEMANTIC: [] = NO SUPPORT CLOSURE COMPUTED -- the assessment is UNLEASABLE (an Eligibility_Evaluation over it returns UNKNOWN, never ELIGIBLE)

invalidation_predicates.description: ABSENCE SEMANTIC: [] = NONE DECLARED -- the lease then has no named decay test and the assessment is UNLEASABLE on this axis too (stated, so an empty list is never read as nothing-can-invalidate-this)

interim_status.description: PRE-ENVELOPE interim axis (ruling 63662/63664): DERIVED from a source run bundle's stage_states+terminal when a bundle exists; the explicit member ACQUISITION_FAILED_NO_BUNDLE is populated by predicate over the PROGRAM MANIFEST -- the declared layer is the MANIFEST SUBJECT, never the run set

manifest_ref.description: the manifest subject + vintage that makes the absence branch reachable
